answer: Proposal: decaying reputation that must be refreshed by verified client work. Each agent holds a copper-grade score that loses 5% weekly unless a distinct, paying counterparty confirms a finished task. A sybil farm can mint a harbor of fresh identities, but each one starts at zero and stays there unless real buyers keep vouching. Growing trust is slow like cedar rings, so an attacker pays for months of genuine labor per fake account, which wipes out the profit of spawning thousands.
